answer_1.quote: We design a two-step summarization framework that takes the FINDINGS (F) section of a radiology report and produces an IMPRESSIONS (I) section.
datasets: radiology reports from two medical centers in the USA

answer_2.quote: We follow standard practice and evaluate the quality of generated IMPRESSIONS by comparing against ground-truth IMPRESSIONS using ROUGE.

answer_4.quote: To assess the overall quality and factual correctness of the IMPRESSIONS generated by DiMAC, we obtained evaluations from two board-certified radiologists.
answer_4.guideline: Each radiologist rated the summaries on two measures in relation to the FINDINGS: (1) overall quality and (2) factual correctness and completeness, scoring as 1 (bad), 2 (borderline), or 3 (good).
